objective: Build the V2 rich pretraining corpus, choose the V2 tokenizer, and freeze a development proxy panel. No model training.
parent_note: V2 trains from random initialization; no parent weights.

selection_rules.tokenizer: Adopt the best candidate only if its bytes/token on held-out mixture text and benchmark-train text is >= 2% higher than the V1 tokenizer; otherwise keep V1's tokenizer. Among passing candidates prefer the smaller vocabulary unless the larger is a further >= 2% better on mixture text (rule added before the study ran).
selection_rules.targeted: Top 20% of Edu+DCLM documents by classifier score; evaluation splits never used.

resume: Rerun the same command; completed files and stage markers are skipped.
